tools.name: Node.js
tools.purpose: Run Next.js apps; use a release supported by the chosen framework.
tools.installation: Install a supported Node.js release from https://nodejs.org/en/download

tools.name: Vercel CLI
tools.purpose: Deploy and inspect Vercel projects; authenticate separately on each device.
tools.installation: See https://vercel.com/docs/cli for installation and login instructions.

tools.name: Supabase CLI runner
tools.purpose: Create and manage hosted Supabase projects, migrations and generated types without a local database.
tools.installation: Install Node.js 20 or later, then add a pinned CLI to each app with npm install --save-dev --save-exact supabase. Run it as npx supabase and authenticate separately on each device.

tools.name: Git
tools.purpose: Clone, commit, push, and pull this repository.
tools.installation: Install Git for Windows from https://git-scm.com/downloads/win

tools.name: PowerShell 7
tools.purpose: Optional newer shell; the scripts also support built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.purpose: Preferred GitHub repository, pull request, issue and workflow management alongside Git.
tools.installation: winget install --id GitHub.cli -e --source winget; then gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web. See cli/README.md.

tools.name: Codex CLI
tools.purpose: Optional terminal use and MCP configuration commands; skills can also be used in the desktop app.
tools.installation: See https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cli for current setup instructions.
